Definition: from the same as G2334; spectatorship, i.e. (concretely) a spectacle:--sight.
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, theōría means a spectacle, a sight. In Luke 23:48, all the people that came together to that sight.
TheologicalSignificance: Crowds going home beating their breasts after watching the crucifixion tell me some sights change a person forever, and that one should.
